evidence.reason: Line 177 expands both `%i` and `%I` with the raw instance text extracted from the unit filename. Systemd defines `%i` as the escaped instance and `%I` as the unescaped instance; for `ingress@crq\x2dtick.socket`, `%I` should resolve to `crq-tick`, not `crq\x2dtick`. The current code therefore misses the intended target-unit reference when `%I` is used. Applying systemd unit-name unescaping only to the `%I` replacement is a routine correctness fix and does not require owner judgment.
